# Ruumly

> Marketplace for storage units, moving services, and trailer rentals across the Baltics (Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania). Up to 10% cheaper than booking direct with verified partners.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search storage, moving, and trailers across the Baltics.
- [Search](/search): Browse and filter all listings on a map.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): Booking flow and platform overview.
- [About](/about): Company background and mission.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about bookings, pricing, and partners.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the Ruumly team.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on storage, moving, and logistics in the Baltics.
